diminazene (berenil), glucose, blood, fluids, oxygen, clopamon

cleaning_notes: One tidy dataset for DS04 and S-CB147 (same 10 fatal dogs). 14 dogs: controls 2, 4, 9, 11; fatal cases 20, 50, 54, 59, 61, 88, 91, 106, 110, 117. Controls have one record (timepoint 'single'); fatal cases have an 'admission' record (signalment, blood) and a 'necropsy' record (liver).
Blood timepoint: CB147 states that serum and EDTA blood were taken before any treatment, so blood values are 'admission'.

Haematology/biochemistry join. The two haematology sheets have no case number, only a 0/1 group flag (4 controls then 10 cases). Rows were joined to case numbers by the order of the IHC sheet in Stats Tables.xlsx (row 1 = control 2, row 2 = control 4, row 3 = control 9, row 4 = control 11; row 5 = case 50, row 6 = case 20, row 7 = case 117, row 8 = case 110, row 9 = case 54, row 10 = case 59, row 11 = case 91, row 12 = case 61, row 13 = case 88, row 14 = case 106). Evidence: (1) the WBC, segmented and band neutrophil counts of case rows 1, 5 and 6 equal S-CB050 cases 126, 127 and 131 (see linkage below), and S-CB050 gives those dogs age 30 months/30.6 kg, 9 months/45.6 kg and 60 months/34 kg, which is the signalment of DS04 cases 50, 54 and 59, the 1st, 5th and 6th cases in the IHC order (chance of three such hits under a random order: 1 in 720); (2) the two dogs whose sheets record non-icteric mucous membranes (88 cyanotic, 106 white) get the two lowest bilirubins (7.2 and 9.4 umol/L); every dog recorded as icteric gets 15.4 umol/L or more. Confidence: high for the fatal cases. The controls (rows 1-4 -> 2, 4, 9, 11) follow the same rule but no value confirms them: moderate confidence.

'stats for haematology (1).xlsx' has the same data rows as 'stats for haematology.xlsx' (identical: True); it lacks the summary rows below the data (extra non-empty rows in the first copy: {'Haematology': 4, 'Biochemistries': 4}). Only the first copy is used.

Linkage to S-CB050 (do not pool): fatal cases 50, 54 and 59 here are S-CB050 cases 126, 127 and 131 (the three deaths of the 2014 cohort), confirmed by identical WBC / segmented / band counts and by age and weight. DS04 is not independent of SRC-A.

S-CB147 (Table_2.DOCX of the article supplement) lists per-case IHC values for the same 10 cases and group medians for controls. All values were compared with the per-dog means computed here (checks file). S-CB147 adds no per-dog value that is not in DS04; its Table_1.DOCX is the blank scoring rubric. No value was taken from S-CB147.

IHC: 3 high-power fields per zone per dog (rows of the IHC sheet). Per-dog value = mean of the non-blank fields; 13 of 756 field cells are blank. The authors' 'Sheet1' averages agree with these means except: case 20 CV Iba-1: fields [11.0, 11.0, None], Sheet1 7.33; case 106 PT CD3: fields [7.0, 7.0, 15.0], Sheet1 14.5. FLAG (kept as computed here): in the first, the authors divided by 3 with a blank field (blank counted as 0); the second does not follow from the fields. The thesis tables and S-CB147 Table_2 carry the authors' values (7.3 and 14.5). The thesis and S-CB147 call the per-case values 'median number of positive cells/HPF', but they equal the mean of the fields (e.g. values in thirds); the zone-level 'total medians' are medians over all fields of the group.
Sheet1 has a stray summary row and two stray case numbers (88, 106) below the data; 'Total Phenotypes' is the sum over zones per field and is not used (derivable).
Special stains (MSB, Perls, LFB): 3 fields per zone per dog; per-dog mean. The scale is not documented (MSB is 0/1; Perls and LFB look like counts).

Histopathology: 33 score sheets. Blank templates not used: 50.2 23.03.2022 - 77-126 (1).xlsx, 88.1 21.03.2022 68-126.xlsx. Item scores are read from the 'Score' column and averaged over the dog's populated sheets (repeat, unblinded scoring sessions of the same specimen, not time points). Controls were scored mostly in January to early March 2022 and cases in March to April 2022 (scorer drift is confounded with group). Narrative fields (autolysis, lesion distribution, congestion, haemorrhage, which are marked by highlighting, not numbers) are not read.

Two sheet templates: the control 'A' sheets (2A, 4A, 9A, 11A; January-February 2022) split extramedullary haematopoiesis into intravascular and extravascular and lack the periportal 'Sinusoids/Space of Disse oedema' row in some sheets; the other sheets have one extramedullary haematopoiesis item. Both forms are kept as separate variables (null where the template lacks them). So item sums are not on one scale across templates.

histo_total_score = mean of the 'Score out of 126' values in the Score Sheet (all listed sessions). The Score Sheet lists a third scoring of control 11 (30) with no sheet file, and 68 for case 88 whose sheet (88.1) is a blank template; these totals are kept in histo_total_score, while the item means use only populated sheets.
Session totals: every populated sheet's total cell equals its file-name total and the sum of its items.
Non-numeric item scores: none.

Signalment comes from the score sheets (free text) and is the same in the dog's sheets except for the control sheets below. Ages in years were converted to months (x12). 'M' without I/C -> neuter null.

FLAG (resolved by the article): control 4 has two signalments: sheets 4.1 and 4A.3 say 'Unknown. 7 months. MI. Pitbull. 12 kg' (the same as case 88's signalment), sheets 4A.1 and 4A.2 say 'Dexter. 3 years. MI. JRT. 7kg'. Control 9: sheets 9A.1-9A.2 say 'Teddy. 3 years. FI. Africanis. 13kg', 9A.3 says '... Bull terrier. 23kg'. The CB147 control means and medians (age 18.3/15.5 months, weight 13.6/12.5 kg, breeds Pitbull, Africanis, Boerboel) are reproduced only with control 4 = Pitbull 7 months 12 kg and control 9 = Africanis 13 kg, so those are used; the other texts are treated as template carry-over. All repeat scorings stay assigned to the case number of the Score Sheet.

FLAG (kept as reported): the fatal cases' ages from the sheets (mean 55.0, median 42 months) do not reproduce the CB147 mean 52.8 and median 50 months, and their weights (8 dogs) give median 32.3 kg against the article's 34 kg (the mean 28.9 kg agrees). The ages are kept as written on the sheets; one or more ages in the article's source must differ.
FLAG (kept as reported): case 106 weighs 3 kg at 3 years (mixed breed). It is consistent with the article's mean weight.
FLAG (kept as reported): case 88 is 'DOA' on its sheet; the same number 88 is in the DS07 'uncomplicated' list (data.md linkage facts; unverified numbering link).

Zero as a missing code: bile_acids_pre (fatal case), bilirubin_total (control), glucose (control), urea (fatal case) zeros were set to null (bilirubin and glucose: not measured in controls per CB147 Table 2; urea and pre-prandial bile acids: 3 fatal cases each, and the CB147 medians 28.3 and 22 are reproduced only without these zeros; the thesis medians 20.7 and 8.5 include them).
FLAG (kept as reported): reticulocyte % is 0 in 6 of 10 fatal cases; true zero or not done is unknown.
FLAG (kept as reported): monocytes 0 x10^9/L in one fatal case.
FLAG (stored as null): globulin 'x' in one fatal case (its TSP minus albumin is 50.9 g/L).
Censored: bile acids '<1' -> 1 (floor) and '>148' -> 148 (ceiling); see 'censored' in the records.
Bile acids post-prandial: controls only (none in fatal cases).
Thesis text vs data: the thesis table gives WCC maximum 105.6 and band minimum 1 x10^9/L; the data hold 103.55 and 0.51. The data values are kept.
Units: urea is 'Urea Nitr. (mmol/L)' in the file, stored as urea mmol/L as written.
All infected dogs are fatal: there is no outcome contrast within infected dogs. The outcome file has died (all 1 for cases) and the death timing text.

IHC group medians: the medians over all fields of each group reproduce the published CB147 Table 3 (checks file). The thesis tables ('all tables from thesis.docx') differ from the data in 13 infected and 6 control marker-zones (e.g. CD3 portal tract 9 vs 12 here and in the article); this answers the S-CB147 record's unreconciled CD3 difference: the article, not the thesis, matches the data.
